name: C&D
description: C&D (Clark and Devon) was a greaser street gang based in the Rogers Park and Edgewater neighborhoods of Chicago, Illinois, named after the intersection of Clark Street and Devon Avenue. Active from the late 1960s into the early 1970s, C&D was closely allied with the Thorndale Jag Offs (TJO) and drew members from the hippie-greaser subculture centered around Sullivan High School and venues like the Aragon Ballroom. The gang was known for defending its North Side turf aggressively.
